errors.evidence: This is an interpretive statement about the rate of growth. While the slope does appear to increase slightly after 2016, describing this as a 'faster rate of growth' goes beyond simple visual description into analysis. The reference description characterizes the trend as a 'uniform increase', indicating that a more neutral description is preferred.
